limits: This review does not claim current legally authoritative cadastral or surveyed quarter boundaries.
Image alignment remains approximate; original labels and matching relative topology were read rather than assigning a name solely by transformed-point inclusion.
No name or OSM name coordinate created, moved, clipped or repaired a polygon.

Four source areas have no-data hatching that cannot silently be treated as true fine borders. Two separate source names are merged by the current detailed-source mask; one tiny source field remains unresolved.
Unresolved in the current density source-mask is not general source absence. Complete solid Figure 9 islands offer additional local tracing possibilities for Árpádtető and Petőfi-akna.
The exact source-cell geometry/topology and geographic calibration still require their separate reviews; this report supplies name/semantic correspondence, not a blanket geographic import approval.
